correctness.rationale: The digit recursion f_d(2t)=f_d(t) and f_d(2t+1)=f_d(t) XOR [t≡2^(d-1)-1] is exact. Its state S=(f(t),f(t+1),t mod2^(d-1)) admits finite appended-digit maps, and a proved two-block identity reduces every possible factor up to length 2^(d+1) to reachable states and residues. Inspected check_factors.py constructs all 14/24 reachable states, verifies closed backward access and stationary rational weights, exhaustively checks every residue and even length, and checks absence at the next even length. Cropping both ends proves no longer factor is possible. Markov primitivity and exact rational aggregation prove natural starting-position densities; direct prefix enumeration independently corroborates the finite lists.
